newsitem.title: FRANCE: SEP delivers Ariane 5 Vulcain motor.
newsitem.headline: SEP delivers Ariane 5 Vulcain motor.

text.p: French rocket motor company SEP said a Vulcain M16 rocket motor left its Vernon factory on Friday for delivery to SNI Aerospatiale for the second test flight of the Ariane-5 rocket.
The delivery of the Vulcain motor to the Mureaux facility met the timetable set by the French CNES space agency, which is the prime contractor for the programme, SEP said in a statement.

Aerospatiale is an industrial partner in the Ariane programme. The maiden flight of the heayweight launcher Ariane-5 ended in disaster in June when the rocket blew up less than 40 seconds after take-off.
French aero-engine maker Snecma has launched a buy-out for the 49 percent of SEP it does not already own.
